beats.narration: Everyone calls Tesla a car company. But its fastest-growing business isn't cars at all.
It's energy — giant batteries that store power for homes and entire electric grids.
That division has been growing faster than the car business for several quarters straight.
And as AI data centers devour electricity, demand for grid-scale storage is exploding.
Higher-margin energy and software could reshape how the entire company is valued.
The car company that quietly became an energy company. Follow for more.
